subject: wait time to load Shiny appli too longer, Do you have any idea

messages.author: 222bbaa6305eef81
messages.subject: wait time to load Shiny appli too longer, Do you have any idea
parts:
Hi,

I developed one R shiny appli,
But I observe that I have a long wait time to load the application. The URL responded quickly but whole service is accessible only after at least 30s in my case. Whole service is ready to use it  when you can see " Welcome to coMET" via tab "coMET". During this period of loading, CPU is around 99%. The duration depends whether other tools use the CPU. It could be longer.

Currently, the appli is on VM ubuntu with 1.6Go of memory for one CPU.

I would like to know what are the basic features of server where Shiny can run well and quick?

do you have some help to reduce the wait time ?


you can find server.R and UI.R on gitHub (https://github.com/TiphaineCMartin/coMET/tree/master/www).

Regards,
Tiphaine
